slides.sub: Do it before you get up!

sections.heading: 1. Knee rocks + log roll
lines: ① Knees bent, rock them side to side 10 times.
② Hug each knee to your chest in turn.
③ Roll onto your side as one unit.
④ Lower your legs and push up with your arms.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…
lines: Pain wakes you and doesn't ease when you
move — check in with your GP.

slides.heading: See your GP promptly if

caption:
Getting out of bed is Koko's hardest moment of the day. After hours of lying still, a sore back usually feels its stiffest first thing, and most people loosen up within 30 to 60 minutes of moving.

Before you get up, rock your bent knees side to side ten times. Then log roll: knees bent, roll onto your side as one unit, legs over the edge and push up with your arms. Save heavy lifting for later in the morning.

Pain that wakes you, numbness around the groin, bladder or bowel changes, leg weakness or fever deserve a prompt GP visit. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help with the rest. Book online via the link in bio.
